vision.paraphrase: Local and private: the page loads nothing from anywhere else.

conops.paraphrase: The page opens in a browser from the local file alone.

vision.paraphrase: Faithful record: a title is shown exactly as typed.

conops.paraphrase: The reader sees every book as they typed it.

requirements.rationale: Whether a page can be taken in at a glance cannot be asserted by a test; a person opens the page and looks.

vision.paraphrase: A glance is enough: a person judges whether the page reads well.

conops.paraphrase: Finished and unfinished books can be told apart without reading the dates.
